promptNote: This shelf is for Landfall Stoicism: the Stoics and the wider philosophy of life. Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus, the Socratic dialogues, Cicero, Boethius, Montaigne, Emerson, Thoreau, the existentialists, virtue ethics, and the practical questions they answer — adversity, grief, anger, discipline, mortality. Tag those Stoic. Tag philosophy, psychology and ethics that a philosophy listener would recognise as theirs Secular. Tag as Interfaith only a conversation in which a philosopher or a philosophical text is one of the voices; a sermon, a scripture study, an apologetics argument or a devotional belongs to its own tradition — give it that tradition's label, which keeps it on its own shelf rather than this one, and rate it low here. That is a shelving decision, not a judgement of the episode. Reject self-improvement content that uses Stoic language as decoration for hustle, productivity, money, dating or masculinity coaching, and reject episodes that are mainly news or politics even when a philosopher is quoted.
